gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase 3, Multicenter, Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Safusidenib Erbumine in Participants With Isocitrate Dehydrogenase 1 (IDH1)-Mutant Glioma
Diagnosis of histologically confirmed IDH1-mutant Grade 2, Grade 3 with high risk features or Grade 4 astrocytoma, per WHO 2021 classification and Investigator Assessment.

Patient must have histologically confirmed recurrent or progressive WHO Grade 2 glioma or Grade 3 glioma with IDH1 R132H or R132C mutation confirmed by immunohistochemistry or molecular genetic testing.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] safusidenib 250mg bid (Part 2): safusidenib administered continuously as dosed single agent orally on Days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The purpose of Part 1 of the study is to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and pharmacokinetic (PK) characteristics of safusidenib in participants with recurrent/progressive IDH1-mutant World Health Organization (WHO) Grade 2 or Grade 3 glioma.

The purpose of Part 2 will be to evaluate the efficacy of maintenance safusidenib treatment versus placebo in IDH1-mutant Grade 2 or Grade 3 astrocytoma with high-risk features or IDH1-mutant Grade 4 astrocytoma, following standard-of-care radiation or chemoradiation and adjuvant temozolomide.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Part2: Safusidenib PK Profile: Defined as safusidenib concentrations and PK parameters.
Part 1: Cmax of safusidenib: Peak Plasma Concentration (Cmax)

role_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] safusidenib 250mg bid (Part 2): safusidenib administered continuously as dosed single agent orally on Days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational mutant IDH1 inhibitor (safusidenib erbumine, DS-1001b, AB-218)

role_evidence.quote: [PLACEBO_COMPARATOR] placebo (Part 2): Placebo administered continuously as dosed single agent orally on Days 1 to 28 of a 28-day cycle.

source_quote.quote: Have an IDH1 mutation (R132H/C/G/S/L) based on IHC (R132H only), polymerase chain reaction (PCR), or next-generation sequencing (NGS).

CDKN2A/B status and at least 1 of the following must be confirmed: absence of 1p19q co-deletion by fluorescence in situ hybridization, array comparative genomic hybridization, or NGS; presence of an ATRX loss of function mutation by NGS; or loss of normal ATRX expression by IHC.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: 1p/19q codeletion (absence required for Part 2; presence required for Part 3)

source_quote.quote: Have an IDH1 mutation (R132H/C/G/S/L). The presence of 1p19q co-deletion must also be confirmed.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: ATRX loss (alternative to absent 1p/19q codeletion for Part 2 entry)

source_quote.quote: presence of an ATRX loss of function mutation by NGS; or loss of normal ATRX expression by IHC.

coder_notes: Population is IDH1-mutant glioma only (grade 2-4 astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma); IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma is not glioblastoma under WHO CNS5, so not_glioblastoma even though the conditions list 'Astrocytoma, Grade IV' (the eligibility requires IDH1 mutation throughout). IDH1 mutation is an entry requirement in all parts and matches the mutant-IDH1 inhibitor safusidenib. Part 1 PK is plasma; Parts 2/3 'safusidenib concentrations' without sample type, coded tumour_pk_planned unclear. Treatment setting: Part 1 recurrent, Part 2 maintenance after first-line therapy, Part 3 residual/recurrent after surgery only -> both. CDKN2A/B is a required documented status for Part 2 rather than a specified value; coded enrichment, not matched. Placebo listed as control comparator.
